Ye mat chaho ki sab easy ho; chaho ki tum behtar bano.
Jahan ho start karo, jo hai use karo.
Jeevan mein aapko kayi haar ka samna karna padega, lekin khud ko kabhi haarne mat dena.
Self-belief action ka fuel hai.
Aaj ka day win karo.
Kal ko realize karne ka ek hi limit hai—aj ke doubts.
"Jo matter karta, uske liye time do."
"Jit unki hoti jo sabr se tikte."
Mann ek bagicha hai; soch beej hain.
Motivation andar se aati hai.
